slides.slide_title: Aksha Surveillance System and Digital Twin Project

key_points: Aksha is an intelligent surveillance system designed for automated monitoring with minimal human intervention.
Utilizes advanced technologies such as Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, and Gen AI.
Focuses on real-time object detection and anomaly identification to enhance safety and security.
24/7 monitoring capabilities with live recording and data processing.
Advanced object detection for various entities including vehicles, people, and unusual behaviors.
Customizable alert systems that allow users to set specific notifications based on detected anomalies.
Transforms traditional CCTV setups into smart surveillance systems, enhancing operational efficiency.
Reduces human monitoring efforts, allowing businesses to allocate resources more effectively.
Low capital expenditure (CapEx) with SaaS-based pricing models, making it accessible for various industries.
Customized solutions for worker safety monitoring in construction and industrial environments.
Real-time insights into worker activities and safety compliance through advanced video analytics.
Seamless integration with existing infrastructure, ensuring minimal disruption during implementation.
Development of a video analytics solution specifically for monitoring worker safety at construction sites.
Utilized Aksha's capabilities to address challenges in real-time monitoring and anomaly detection.
Phased implementation approach tailored to client needs, enhancing adaptability and effectiveness.
Collaboration with NDIL to customize Aksha for enhanced worker safety features.
Successful integration of Gen AI to improve detection accuracy and reporting capabilities.
Phased development approach with continuous support to optimize performance on edge devices.
Positive feedback highlighting the reduction in human monitoring efforts and improved anomaly detection.
Clients appreciate the flexibility and customization options that Aksha provides.
Recognition of Aksha's role in transforming traditional surveillance into proactive safety management.
Ongoing enhancements to Aksha's features, including further integration of Gen AI capabilities.
Plans for expanding applications across various sectors beyond construction and industrial domains.
Commitment to continuous improvement based on client feedback and technological advancements.
Aksha represents a significant advancement in surveillance technology, prioritizing safety and efficiency.
Encouragement for stakeholders to explore Aksha's capabilities for their specific business needs.
Invitation for further discussions on implementation strategies and potential collaborations.
